Name: Spamton Glasses
Author: marmuruah
Description:
Replaces one of farmer's accessories (№12) to Spamton's glasses. 
This mod may not be compatible with other mods that replace farmer's accessories.
There is also a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36874]Fashion Sense version of the mod[/url], which includes not only the glasses but also Spamton’s hair and shirt.
